metadata.description: Contributions, aid cases and monthly reports for the Ehsas Program welfare fund of Megowal village.

landing.about: Ehsas Program is a welfare fund run by the people of Megowal village. Members give a fixed amount every month, and the fund helps families in need with weddings, funerals, medical treatment, school fees and other needs. Every rupee is recorded openly.
landing.loginNote: Members and heads log in with their mobile number.

transparent.title: Open accounts
transparent.body: Every month's report shows the total collected, the total spent and the balance.

aid.title: Help tracked to the end
aid.body: Every aid case is followed from request to completion, and families' names stay private.

members.title: Check anytime
members.body: Members can see their contributions, pending months and reports on their phone.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Enter your mobile number and password.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the admin to reset it.

account.name: Name
account.changePasswordSubtitle: Use at least 8 characters. Do not share it with anyone.
account.forcedSubtitle: You logged in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
account.languageSubtitle: Choose the language for your screens.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: People who can log in to the app
users.emptyBody: Try a different search, or add a user.

form.createSubtitle: A temporary password is made for the new user.
form.name: Full name
form.memberHint: Required for members. Heads can be linked to their own member record.

users.confirmDisableBody: They will not be able to log in until you enable them again.
users.confirmResetBody: A new temporary password will be made. Their old password stops working straight away.
users.tempBody: Give this password to {name}. They must change it after logging in. It will not be shown again.

validation.mobileFormat: Mobile number must start with 03 and have 11 digits.
validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.passwordsDontMatch: The two passwords do not match.
validation.passwordSameAsOld: New password must be different from the current one.
validation.memberRequired: A member login must be linked to a member record.
